_doc: Weapon grip point of the unit's hand in each DRPG wait (idle) frame: unit -> sheet -> one [x, y] or [x, y, rot] per wait slot 0-4, slot coordinates of drpg_slots.json in atlas orientation (wait_back is drawn mirrored in game: an atlas-left hand is on the screen-right side in game). drpgmap.anchor_on_hands puts the stand pose's weapon rig on this point (mirrored automatically when the hand is on the other side of the body than the stand pose's weapon hand; optional 'mirror': {sheet: true|false} overrides). rot (degrees, clockwise) turns the weapon about the hand. Units without an entry get automatic hand detection (the build log prints suggested points) or no idle weapon.

10030._name: Onmyo Monk: the closed fist (the hand that is not pointing)
